plugins.name: westland
plugins.description: Westland Construction organizational plugin — always-loaded safety hooks and progressively-disclosed company style references. Install first on every Westland machine; required dependency of the domain plugins (scheduling, estimating, etc.). Contains: Westland Project Files PreToolUse hook (three-rule policy on the Westland share — modify-prompt, version-controlled-deny, delete-deny) and the westland-house-style skill.

plugins.name: scheduling
plugins.description: Claude Code skills for construction scheduling — Westland standards, P6 XER operations, proposal schedules with self-contained Gantt review HTML + Copy-for-Claude iteration loop, reviewer-feedback download for external reviewers (attribution-tagged JSON), and a single propsched dispatcher (iterate, paths, anchors, diff, walk, score, init, bootstrap-anchors, aggregate-postmortems, feedback, metadata, durations). v5.1.0: SmartPM v2 headless auto-login screenshots (replaces v1 + Playwright MCP), URL-search project lookup, smartpm_project_name field in project-context, @playwright/test smoke suite.

plugins.name: estimating
plugins.description: Claude Code skills for construction estimating — bid reviews, scope gap analysis, and bid leveling.

plugins.name: project-management
plugins.description: Claude Code skills for construction project management — submittals, specs, meeting minutes, change events, and change orders.

plugins.name: site-operations
plugins.description: Claude Code skills for construction site and field operations — RFIs, daily logs, and field workflows.

plugins.name: safety
plugins.description: Claude Code skills for construction safety — toolbox talks, JSAs, orientations, and incident reports.
